title: Taygete at SemEval-2022 Task 4: RoBERTa based models for detecting Patronising and Condescending Language

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating RoBERTa-based binary and multi-label classification models on their ability to detect Patronising and Condescending Language (PCL) directed at socioeconomically disadvantaged groups using dataset keywords like 'homeless', 'poor families', and 'in need'.

Evaluating RoBERTa-based classification models on detecting Patronising and Condescending Language (PCL) directed at displaced or migrating populations using dataset keywords like 'immigrant', 'migrant', and 'refugee'.
Evaluating RoBERTa-based classification models on detecting Patronising and Condescending Language (PCL) directed at individuals with disabilities using the dataset keyword 'disabled'.
Evaluating RoBERTa-based classification models on detecting Patronising and Condescending Language (PCL) directed at women using the dataset keyword 'women'.
